key_patterns: unique_name_in_owner is tree-position-independent: re-parenting a node keeps %Name resolving from the MainUI owner as long as the node stays in MainUI's owned subtree and the flag stays set — this is the linchpin for keeping %HandStrip/%ClubRow/%ModifierRow/%ShootButton green with zero script edits. Shaders are procedural value-noise (hash2/value_noise helpers in turf.gdshader) — no imported textures; felt_tray reuses that family. Mesh .tres files PIN shader_parameter/... overrides, so raising shader-file defaults alone renders NOTHING on those tiles — the .tres values are what render. Control shaders attach via node.material (ShaderMaterial), not via theme_override_styles/panel. Layout is anchor-based (0..0.75 / 0.75..1.0) and resolution-agnostic — no hardcoded 1920x1080 on HoleViewer/Tray. HoleViewer shares the main World3D (_share_world) and registers its camera via hex_grid.set_external_camera for picking.
